step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify visual nodes from the whiteboard: Service Teams (UserCompanyDeveloper), ECS (running Kong gateway), Lambda (processing logic), DynamoDB (storing build events), RDS PostgreSQL (storing compliance frameworks), and SNS (for cross-account promotion/notifications).
2. Trace entry points and logical flow based on diagram and audio transcript:
   - Non-production pipelines / Service Teams send build events to Kong running on ECS.
   - ECS passes these events to AWS Lambda.
   - Lambda captures and stores the build events in DynamoDB.
   - On promotion/compliance checks, Lambda evaluates DynamoDB build events against compliance rules stored in RDS PostgreSQL.
   - Upon successful compliance verification, Lambda triggers promotion notifications via SNS to the production environment.
